verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model and fine-tuning platform with a dashboard, CLI and API, so an in-product assistant is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in assistant that users can delegate platform tasks to. Driving the platform from an external coding agent with an API key is a user-side workaround, and the browser and home-automation demos showcase the models themselves rather than an assistant inside the product.
